Transparent background in every cell, true alpha, NO colored backing or checkerboard painted into image. Frame order left-to-right, top-to-bottom. The same complete food cluster centered inside each cell, about 75 percent cell width and 65 percent cell height, with steam within bounds. Crisp chunky low-resolution game pixels, enough detail to read as rice and braised pork when each frame is downscaled to 64x32 pixels. Output just the 2x2 four-frame transparent sprite sheet.
